hero.whatsappMessage: Hi Helix24, I would like a quote for a website.

faqs.q: How long does it take to build a website?
faqs.a: A typical business website takes 2 to 3 weeks from approved design to launch. Larger web applications, portals and dashboards usually take 4 to 8 weeks, with demos at each milestone.

faqs.q: Why do you build with Next.js instead of WordPress?
faqs.a: Next.js sites load quickly, need far fewer plugins and are easier to keep secure. WordPress is still a sensible choice for some businesses, and we will tell you honestly which suits your needs and budget.

faqs.q: Can I update the website content myself?
faqs.a: Yes. We can include a simple content editor so you can change text, photos and blog posts without a developer.

faqs.q: Who owns the website once it is built?
faqs.a: You do. The code, domain and hosting accounts are set up in your name.
